headline: Every box checked before it is bundled.
label: #efe3cf
heroLede: A box with the wrong print or an open glue joint stops your customer's packing line, not just yours. Here's what a camera check could look like at the end of your converting lines. Scroll through, then adjust the estimate at the end to your own numbers.
lidLede: The camera checks every box is glued, folded square and undamaged. An open glue joint or a crushed corner is the fault your customer finds when the box will not erect on their line.
labelLede: Two print jobs for the same customer can look much the same at speed. The camera checks every box carries the right print for the order, straight, clean and complete.
codeLede: The order and run marks tie every bundle back to its job. The system reads them on every box and compares them with the order set at changeover.
objectLede: Board offcuts, strapping and loose parts can end up on the conveyor. The camera over the belt spots anything that should not be there before boxes are bundled.

vocab.alert: Four skewed flaps in fifteen minutes on the folder-gluer. Check the guides.
